BranchBack

Understand your Git checkout, review an upcoming push, and preview recovery from a wrong-branch commit.

Get the development CLI

From the BranchBack checkout, run npm install --global .. Then open the repository you want to inspect. You’ll need Git and Python 3 on your PATH.

Pick up where you left off

git branchback explain

See your current branch, unfinished changes, upstream relationship and any active Git operation. Add --json for scripts.

Review a push

git branchback prepush

Review your current branch’s destination, outgoing commits and changed paths using local tracking information. Add --json to read the report in a script.

Preview wrong-branch recovery

git branchback feature/invoice

See where both branch tips would point and count your staged, unstaged and untracked changes. For the latest two commits together, use git branchback --commits 2 feature/invoice.

The 0.1.0 npm release supports single-commit recovery previews. The development checkout includes all commands shown above.
